description: BEP - indicateurs de gestion des déchets is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by BEP. Mise en CET (Centre d'Enfouissement Technique) directe par rapport au gisement global des déchets The 8 datasets in this record: Mise en CET directe par rapport au gisement global des déchets; Production de déchets par habitant; Taux de compostage/biométhanisation; Taux de recyclage par rapport au gisement global; Taux de valorisation énergétique; Tonnage d'encombrants collectés par ... Coverage: Province of Namur (Wallonia). The portal lists 8 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement, Administration et Services publics. Its keywords are Indicateurs, Environnement. The portal shows 12 records. The most recent modification among them is 2026-08-27 on the portal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
